notes:
Account background: TerraConversation Labs runs a multilingual cloud contact center platform used by EU telcos and banks. Narrowed scope to agent-assist + ticket summarization + translation pipeline for Tier 1/2. They ingest voice transcripts + ticket history; want context-aware tone suggestions per locale.

Key requirements / constraints:
- Latency: p95 <= 200ms for agent-assist suggestions in UI (desktop agent). If not possible, need graceful degrade to async suggestions.
- Throughput: baseline 1.5k concurrent agent sessions; peak bursts up to 15k (10x) during promos/incident days.
- Languages: priority list ~30 languages incl. Arabic, Hindi, Russian, Polish, Portuguese-BR, Japanese; must preserve locale tone and formality (tu/vous).
- Data residency: transcripts and ticket content for EU customers must not leave EU; retention controls required.
- Security: SOC2 + ISO27001 required, KMS/HSM for keying, audit logs retention 3+ years, SSO/SAML + SCIM.
- Tool-calling: agent actions (CRM updates, ticket tagging, escalation creation) must be idempotent and double-confirm on destructive ops. Audit trail required.

PoC plan / timeline:
- 2026-01-30: Intro + product fit call (Fireflies: ff-2026-01-30-09-14-22).
- 2026-02-14: Security deep-dive + architecture (Fireflies: ff-2026-02-14-11-52-03). Received initial security questionnaire (Drive link).
- PoC steps: 1) sample dataset upload (anonymized) 2) hosted test with EU-only region + VPC peering 3) side-by-side agent assist for 100 agents for 2 weeks 4) spike test simulating 10x bursts 5) run qualitative tone evaluation with localized SMEs.
- PoC blockers: need signed NDA and security addendum before staging data; legal has minor contract edits (SLAs on availability & incident response).

Customer quotes & signals:
- "Tone matters — French customers expect formal phrasing; direct translation fails." — Head of CX
- Very sensitive to mistakes when tool-calling: "If the bot tags wrong account we're liable."

Technical notes / preferences from SI/Platform team:
- Prefer models that support streaming token-level edits and function/tool-call hooks.
- Want automatic fallback routing: if locale model unavailable route to English fallback but mark suggestion as 'translated'.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/caching — they see potential for KV prefix caching of customer history to reduce token cost.
- Request: workload profiling run on existing logs to produce recommended batch sizes and quantization profile.

Next steps (actionable):
- Send draft security addendum and PoC SOW (AE).
- SE to produce estimated infra cost for dedicated EU pool + spike cushion (Lina Park).
- Set up SAML test IdP in staging (security team).
- Schedule 2-week side-by-side PoC window in May after budget sign-off.
